questions.question_en: Which statement about green and gold, Australia's national colours, is correct?
options_en: They are usually seen on the uniforms of national sports teams
They are the colours of the Australian National Flag
They are the colours of the Torres Strait Islander Flag
questions.gist_zh: 問：關於國家代表色，哪句話是對的？
questions.explain_zh: 國家運動隊的隊服通常是綠色和金色。國旗是藍、白、紅；托雷斯海峽島民旗是綠、藍、黑、白，裏面沒有金色。

questions.question_en: Which of these is NOT on the Australian National Flag?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項不在澳大利亞國旗上？（NOT = 不是）
questions.explain_zh: 國旗上有英國國旗（Union Jack）、聯邦星和南十字星（Southern Cross）。金合歡出現在國徽背景上，不在國旗上。

questions.question_en: In which corner of the Australian National Flag is the Union Jack?
questions.gist_zh: 問：Union Jack 在國旗的哪個角？
questions.explain_zh: Union Jack 在國旗的左上角，代表英國定居的歷史，以及我們繼承的法律和制度。

questions.question_en: How many points does the Commonwealth Star have?
questions.gist_zh: 問：Commonwealth Star 有幾個角？
questions.explain_zh: 聯邦星有七個角：六個角各代表一個州，另一個角代表領地。

questions.question_en: On the Commonwealth Star, what does the seventh point stand for?
questions.gist_zh: 問：聯邦星的第七個角代表什麼？
questions.explain_zh: 六個角代表六個州，第七個角代表領地（territories）。它不是隻代表首都領地。

questions.question_en: Which shape on the Australian Aboriginal Flag stands for the sun?
questions.gist_zh: 問：澳大利亞原住民旗上，哪個圖形代表太陽？
questions.explain_zh: 黃色圓圈代表太陽。上半部分黑色代表原住民，下半部分紅色代表土地。

questions.question_en: Which statement about the Australian Aboriginal Flag is incorrect?
options_en: The top half is red and stands for the Aboriginal peoples
The yellow circle stands for the sun
The red part stands for the earth
questions.gist_zh: 問：關於原住民旗，哪句話是錯的？（incorrect = 錯的）
questions.explain_zh: 上半部分是黑色，代表原住民，不是紅色。紅色代表土地，黃色圓圈代表太陽。

questions.question_en: What do the green stripes on the Torres Strait Islander Flag represent?
questions.gist_zh: 問：托雷斯海峽島民旗上的綠色條紋代表什麼？
questions.explain_zh: 綠色條紋代表土地，中間藍色代表海，黑線代表島民，白星的角代表各島羣，白色象徵和平。

questions.question_en: Which city is the capital of the state of Tasmania?
questions.gist_zh: 問：塔斯馬尼亞州的首府是哪個城市？
questions.explain_zh: 塔斯馬尼亞州（Tasmania）的首府是霍巴特（Hobart）。阿德萊德是南澳州的首府。

questions.question_en: According to Aboriginal legend, how were the colours of the opal created?
options_en: A fire burned across the desert
The sea met the red sky
questions.gist_zh: 問：按照原住民傳説，opal 的顏色是怎麼來的？
questions.explain_zh: 傳説一道彩虹觸到了大地，造出了蛋白石（opal）的顏色。opal 是澳大利亞的國家寶石。

questions.question_en: At which of these is 'Advance Australia Fair' sung?
options_en: A meeting of the High Court
questions.gist_zh: 問：'Advance Australia Fair' 會在哪種場合唱？
questions.explain_zh: 國歌在全國性的重要場合演唱，包括入籍儀式和大型體育賽事。法庭審判和高等法院會議不唱國歌。

questions.question_en: Which of these was NOT set up at Federation in 1901?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項不是1901年根據新憲法設立的？（NOT = 不是）
questions.explain_zh: 1901年聯邦成立時，全國議會、政府和高等法院（High Court）隨憲法設立。第一個囚犯定居點是1788年第一艦隊建的。

questions.question_en: Which colony did the British set up first?
questions.gist_zh: 問：英國人最先建立的 colony 是哪一個？
questions.explain_zh: 新南威爾士是英國人建立的第一個殖民地，首府是悉尼。

questions.question_en: During the gold rush, what happened to Australia's population in ten years?
questions.gist_zh: 問：淘金熱的十年裏，澳大利亞的人口發生了什麼變化？
questions.explain_zh: 十年裏人口增加了一倍多，因為世界各地的人湧來淘金。

questions.question_en: Anzac Day is a day to remember all of these EXCEPT…
options_en: the arrival of the First Fleet
Australians who served in peacekeeping operations
questions.gist_zh: 問：Anzac Day 紀念下面所有的人和事，除了哪一項？（EXCEPT = 除了）
questions.explain_zh: Anzac Day 紀念所有在戰爭、衝突和維和行動中服役和犧牲的澳大利亞人。第一艦隊抵達是 Australia Day 紀念的事。

questions.question_en: In which places is Australia Day a public holiday?
questions.gist_zh: 問：Australia Day 在哪些地方是公共假日？
questions.explain_zh: 1月26日的 Australia Day 在每個州和領地都是公共假日，也是澳大利亞最大的年度公共假日。

questions.question_en: At a meeting, who would generally give an Acknowledgement of Country?
options_en: The Chair or Master of Ceremonies
questions.gist_zh: 問：開會時，通常由誰來做 Acknowledgement of Country？
questions.explain_zh: 在會議和活動上，通常由主持人（Chair）或司儀（Master of Ceremonies）致 Acknowledgement of Country，任何人都可以做，不限原住民長老。

questions.question_en: Which of these is NOT a form a Welcome to Country can take?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項不是 Welcome to Country 的形式？（NOT = 不是）
questions.explain_zh: Welcome to Country 可以是歌曲、舞蹈、煙燻儀式，或用傳統語言或英語的講話。觀眾投票不是其中之一。

questions.question_en: At the citizenship ceremony, new citizens pledge to share what?
options_en: The beliefs of their birth country
A fixed share of their income
questions.gist_zh: 問：入籍儀式上，新公民宣誓要分享（share）什麼？
questions.explain_zh: 宣誓時，新公民承諾認同並分享澳大利亞的民主信念，也尊重這裏的權利和自由。

questions.question_en: In the citizenship pledge, what does 'from this time forward' mean?
options_en: From now and in the future
From the day the application was lodged
questions.gist_zh: 問：誓詞裏的 'from this time forward' 是什麼意思？
questions.explain_zh: 'From this time forward' 的意思是從現在起，以後一直如此。承諾不是隻管到下次選舉，也不是從遞交申請那天算起。

questions.question_en: A special citizenship ceremony may be part of the events on which national day?
questions.gist_zh: 問：哪個全國性節日會舉辦特別的入籍儀式（citizenship ceremonies）？
questions.explain_zh: Australia Day 當天各地有很多活動，其中包括特別的入籍儀式。Anzac Day 是肅穆的紀念日。

questions.question_en: Joining the Defence Force is a choice. What is every citizen's responsibility, though?
options_en: To be ready to defend Australia if needed
To seek work in the Defence Force
To serve on a jury in a military court
questions.gist_zh: 問：加入國防軍是自願的，但公民仍有什麼責任？
questions.explain_zh: 服役是自願的，但每位公民都有責任在需要時保衞澳大利亞（defend Australia should the need arise）。書裏沒有説要服兵役兩年。

questions.question_en: Which statement about jury service in Australia is incorrect?
options_en: Every jury hears the evidence in the case
Citizens whose names are on the electoral roll may be called
questions.gist_zh: 問：關於 jury service，哪句話是錯的？（incorrect = 錯的）
questions.explain_zh: 陪審團是一羣普通的澳大利亞男女，聽取證據後判斷被告有罪或無罪。不是隻有律師才能當陪審員。

questions.question_en: Which of these is never acceptable in Australia?
options_en: Trying to incite violence against a group of people
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項在澳大利亞永遠不可接受？（never = 永遠不）
questions.explain_zh: 批評政府和和平集會都是允許的。鼓吹對某個人或羣體使用暴力，永遠不可接受，違反澳大利亞的價值觀和法律。

questions.question_en: Freedom of association lets people join groups such as unions and parties, unless the group is what?
questions.gist_zh: 問：人們可以自由加入政黨、工會等團體，除非該組織是什麼？（unless = 除非）
questions.explain_zh: 人們可以加入任何合法（legal）的組織。宗教和文化團體也是允許的，只有非法組織不行。

questions.question_en: Which statement about the Rule of Law is incorrect?
options_en: Religious leaders must obey the law
Government leaders are above the law
questions.gist_zh: 問：關於 Rule of Law，哪句話是錯的？（incorrect = 錯的）
questions.explain_zh: Rule of Law 下，沒有人在法律之上，包括政府、社區和宗教領袖、商人和警察。説政府領導人在法律之上是錯的。

questions.question_en: Australians value living peacefully. Which of these is NOT a way they believe change should happen?
options_en: Using violence to change a person's mind
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項不是澳大利亞人認為改變應該發生的方式？（NOT = 不是）
questions.explain_zh: 澳大利亞人相信改變應通過討論、和平説服和民主程序。他們反對用暴力改變別人的想法或法律。

questions.question_en: A citizen aged 18 or over can vote in an election, unless what is true?
options_en: They did not go to school in Australia
questions.gist_zh: 問：18歲以上的公民可以投票，除非出現什麼情況？（unless = 除非）
questions.explain_zh: 沒有正確登記（enrol）上選民名冊，就不能投票。工作時間和上學經歷都不影響投票資格。

questions.question_en: Taxes are spent on all of these EXCEPT…
questions.gist_zh: 問：税收用在下面所有項目上，除了哪一項？（EXCEPT = 除了）
questions.explain_zh: 税收用於醫療、教育、國防、道路鐵路和社會保障等服務，不是用來給私人公司賺取利潤。

questions.question_en: Which of these is an Australian citizen aged 18 or over required to do?
options_en: Vote in federal and state elections
questions.gist_zh: 問：18歲以上的澳大利亞公民被要求（required to）做哪件事？
questions.explain_zh: 公民有責任在聯邦和州或領地選舉以及全民公決中投票。加入政黨和做志願者是自由選擇，不是責任。

questions.question_en: Under Australian law, how are Buddhists treated compared with Christians?
questions.gist_zh: 問：在澳大利亞法律下，佛教徒和基督徒相比，受到怎樣的對待？
questions.explain_zh: 法律面前人人平等：佛教徒和其他信仰的人，與基督徒得到同樣的對待，不會被偏袒，也不會被歧視。

questions.question_en: Voting is compulsory. A citizen skips voting in an election without a good reason. What may happen?
options_en: They must retake the citizenship test
questions.gist_zh: 問：公民沒有正當理由不投票，可能會怎樣？
questions.explain_zh: 投票是強制的（compulsory）。沒有好的理由不投票，可能會被罰款。不會因此失去公民身份。

questions.question_en: Which of these protests would be lawful in Australia?
options_en: A peaceful gathering against a government action
A protest that injures a police officer
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪種抗議在澳大利亞是合法的？
questions.explain_zh: 澳大利亞人可以聚集起來和平抗議政府的行動，但抗議必須和平，不能傷人，也不能破壞財物。

questions.question_en: Which statement about newspapers, television and radio outlets in Australia is correct?
options_en: They must print only what the government approves
They have the same freedom as individuals
They may not criticise elected leaders
questions.gist_zh: 問：關於澳大利亞的報紙、電視和電台，哪句話是對的？
questions.explain_zh: 報紙、電視和電台與個人享有同樣的言論自由，只要合法。它們不需要政府批准，也可以批評當選的領導人。

questions.question_en: In Australia, what must people still do while using their freedom of speech?
questions.gist_zh: 問：行使 freedom of speech 時，人們仍然必須做什麼？
questions.explain_zh: 言論自由有前提：任何時候都必須遵守澳大利亞法律。你可以批評政府，但不用事先申請許可，也不必同意政府。

questions.question_en: Which statement about freedom of religion in Australia is correct?
options_en: Religious laws come before Australian law
People may choose to follow no religion
questions.gist_zh: 問：關於 freedom of religion，哪句話是對的？
questions.explain_zh: 在澳大利亞，人們可以選擇任何宗教，也可以選擇不信教。宗教法律沒有法律地位，澳大利亞法律優先；也沒有官方國教。

questions.question_en: In which of these situations can an Australian official overseas give consular assistance to a citizen?
options_en: Getting out of a local law you broke
Paying for a holiday you cannot afford
questions.gist_zh: 問：在海外遇到哪種情況，可以請求 consular assistance？
questions.explain_zh: 海外的澳大利亞官員可以在緊急情況下幫助公民，例如社會動亂和自然災害，也可以協助補發緊急護照，或在事故、重病和死亡時提供建議和支持。

questions.question_en: Which of these is a privilege of Australian citizenship?
options_en: Applying for a Defence Force job
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項是澳大利亞公民的 privilege？
questions.explain_zh: 公民可以申請在澳大利亞公共服務部門和國防軍工作，這是特權。税和法律對公民依然適用。

questions.question_en: Of the responsibilities of citizens aged 18 or over, which one is also a privilege?
options_en: Voting in federal and state elections
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項既是 responsibility 又是 privilege？
questions.explain_zh: 投票在書裏被稱為責任、權利和特權，兩張清單裏都有。陪審團是責任，申請護照只是特權。

questions.question_en: A person wants to report racism or discrimination. Which independent body can receive the complaint?
questions.gist_zh: 問：想舉報 racism 或 discrimination，可以向哪個獨立機構投訴？
questions.explain_zh: 澳大利亞人權委員會（Australian Human Rights Commission）是獨立機構，調查歧視和侵犯人權的投訴。選舉委員會管選舉。

questions.question_en: What do most Australians send to the Australian Taxation Office every year?
questions.gist_zh: 問：大多數澳大利亞人每年要向 ATO 提交什麼？
questions.explain_zh: 每年大多數澳大利亞人要向澳大利亞税務局（ATO）提交報税表（tax return）。

questions.question_en: In the glossary, what does it mean to 'respect' someone's decision?
options_en: To show consideration for the person
To agree with what they decided
To ask them to change their mind
questions.gist_zh: 問：詞彙表裏，respect 一個人的決定是什麼意思？
questions.explain_zh: Respect 是對一個人及其決定表示體諒和尊重，不等於同意，也不是勸他改變。

questions.question_en: From what age can an Australian citizen be asked to serve on a jury?
questions.gist_zh: 問：公民從幾歲起可能被要求參加 jury？
questions.explain_zh: 陪審團服務是18歲及以上公民的責任，名字在選民名冊上的公民可能被叫到。

questions.question_en: Which House of the Australian Parliament is also called the Lower House?
questions.gist_zh: 問：澳大利亞議會的哪一院也叫 Lower House？
questions.explain_zh: 眾議院（House of Representatives）也叫 Lower House 或 People's House。參議院（Senate）才是 Upper House。

questions.question_en: The Upper House is sometimes called the States' House. Which House is it?
questions.gist_zh: 問：哪一院有時被稱為 States' House？
questions.explain_zh: 參議院（Senate）有時叫 Upper House、House of Review 或 States' House。各州不論大小或人口，在參議院里人數相同。Cabinet 不是議院。

questions.question_en: Which of these is NOT another name for the House of Representatives?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一個不是眾議院（House of Representatives）的別名？（NOT = 不是）
questions.explain_zh: 眾議院的別名是 Lower House 和 People's House。House of Review 是參議院的別名之一。

questions.question_en: About how many members are elected to the House of Representatives?
questions.gist_zh: 問：眾議院大約有多少名議員？
questions.explain_zh: 眾議院有150多名議員，各州和領地的議員人數按人口決定。76 是參議員的總數。

questions.question_en: How many senators are there in the Senate in total?
questions.gist_zh: 問：參議院一共有多少名參議員？
questions.explain_zh: 參議院共有76名參議員。150多是眾議院的議員人數；12 是每個州選出的參議員人數。

questions.question_en: How many senators does each state elect to the Senate?
questions.gist_zh: 問：每個州選出多少名參議員（senators）？
questions.explain_zh: 每個州選12名參議員，不論州的大小或人口。首都領地和北領地各選2名。

questions.question_en: Neither the Australian Capital Territory nor the Northern Territory elects twelve senators. How many does each of them elect to the Senate?
questions.gist_zh: 問：首都領地和北領地都不是選12名參議員。它們各選幾名？（neither…nor = 既不…也不）
questions.explain_zh: 首都領地（ACT）和北領地（NT）各選2名參議員，一共4名；每個州選12名，所以共76名。

questions.question_en: A Member of Parliament in the House of Representatives represents whom?
questions.gist_zh: 問：眾議院的議員（MP）代表誰？
questions.explain_zh: 每位議員（MP）代表自己選區（electorate）內的人民。國王由總督在澳大利亞代表，不是議員。

questions.question_en: Which of these is NOT another name for an electorate?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一個不是選區（electorate）的別名？（NOT = 不是）
questions.explain_zh: 選區也叫 electoral district、division 或 seat。Shire 是地方政府區域，不是選區。

questions.question_en: Why is voting in Australia done by secret ballot?
options_en: So voters are free and safe to choose any candidate
So the government can check each vote
So parties can learn who supports them
questions.gist_zh: 問：澳大利亞為什麼用 secret ballot 投票？
questions.explain_zh: 秘密投票讓選民可以自由、安全地選擇任何候選人，沒有人知道你投給了誰。不是為了讓政府或政黨查看。

questions.question_en: Voting is by secret ballot. Nobody may find out which candidate you chose, unless what?
options_en: They work for the electoral commission
questions.gist_zh: 問：沒有人可以知道你投給了誰，除非什麼情況？（unless = 除非）
questions.explain_zh: 投票是秘密的，只有你自己選擇告訴別人時，別人才會知道。警察和選舉委員會的工作人員也不能查。

questions.question_en: What are the Australian Greens?
options_en: An independent commission that runs elections
questions.gist_zh: 問：Australian Greens 是什麼？
questions.explain_zh: Australian Greens（綠黨）是澳大利亞的主要政黨之一，其他主要政黨有自由黨、工黨和國家黨。選舉委員會和聯邦警察是政府機構，不是政黨。

questions.question_en: People who become ministers are recommended from all of these groups EXCEPT…
options_en: members of the House of Representatives
questions.gist_zh: 問：部長（ministers）由總理從下面所有羣體中推薦，除了哪一個？（EXCEPT = 除了）
questions.explain_zh: 總理推薦眾議院議員或參議員出任部長，由總督批准任命。法官屬於司法，不是部長的來源。

questions.question_en: Which of these does NOT hold executive power?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一個沒有 executive power？（NOT = 不是）
questions.explain_zh: 行政權力包括總理、部長和總督。法官屬於司法權力，獨立於議會和政府。

questions.question_en: Which statement about the King of Australia is incorrect?
options_en: He is Australia's Head of State
He appoints the Governor-General to represent him
He has a day-to-day role in running the government
questions.gist_zh: 問：關於澳大利亞國王，哪句話是錯的？（incorrect = 錯的）
questions.explain_zh: 國王是國家元首，任命總督作為他的代表。但國王在日常政府工作中沒有角色。

questions.question_en: Regardless of whether the offender is a man or a woman, what can happen to a person who commits domestic and family violence?
options_en: They are sent home to their family
questions.gist_zh: 問：不管施暴者是男是女（regardless of），家庭暴力的人可能面臨什麼？
questions.explain_zh: 家庭暴力是違法的，不論男女，犯罪者都可能坐牢。

questions.question_en: Which of these is NOT another name for the Australian Government?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪個不是 Australian Government 的別名？（NOT = 不是）
questions.explain_zh: Australian Government 也叫 Federal Government 或 Commonwealth Government。State Government 是州政府，是另一級政府。

questions.question_en: Which body makes laws, instead of interpreting them or putting them into practice?
questions.gist_zh: 問：哪個機構負責制定法律，而不是解釋或執行法律？（instead of = 而不是）
questions.explain_zh: 議會（Parliament）有權制定和修改法律。法院解釋法律，行政部門（Executive）執行法律。

questions.question_en: The Australian Parliament has two Houses. Which of these is NOT one of them?
questions.gist_zh: 問：澳大利亞議會有兩院，下面哪一個不是？（NOT = 不是）
questions.explain_zh: 議會有眾議院和參議院兩院。Cabinet 是由最重要部長組成的內閣，不是議院。

questions.question_en: After a majority in each House agrees to a Bill, where does the Bill go next?
questions.gist_zh: 問：兩院多數都同意一項 Bill 後，下一步交給誰？
questions.explain_zh: 兩院多數同意後，Bill 交給總督，總督簽署後成為法律，這叫 Royal Assent。

questions.question_en: Which national institution is located in Canberra, together with Parliament House?
questions.gist_zh: 問：除了國會大廈，下面哪個國家機構也在堪培拉？
questions.explain_zh: 堪培拉有多個國家機構，包括國會大廈（Parliament House）和澳大利亞高等法院（High Court）。

questions.question_en: Courts and judges are independent of which two bodies?
questions.gist_zh: 問：法院和法官獨立於哪兩個機構？
questions.explain_zh: 法官有權解釋和適用法律。法院和法官獨立於議會和政府。

questions.question_en: Which police force investigates drug trafficking and crimes against national security?
questions.gist_zh: 問：哪個警察機構調查毒品販運和危害國家安全的罪行？
questions.explain_zh: 澳大利亞聯邦警察（AFP）調查違反聯邦法律的罪行，例如毒品販運和危害國家安全；各州有自己的警察。

questions.question_en: Which level of government is responsible for public transport?
questions.gist_zh: 問：哪一級政府負責公共交通（public transport）？
questions.explain_zh: 州和領地政府主要負責醫院、學校、道路鐵路、警察和救護，以及公共交通。

questions.question_en: Which level of government looks after parks, playgrounds and local libraries?
questions.gist_zh: 問：哪一級政府負責公園、遊樂場和本地圖書館？
questions.explain_zh: 公園、遊樂場、本地圖書館等社區設施由地方政府（local government）負責。

questions.question_en: Which level of government is responsible for postal services?
questions.gist_zh: 問：哪一級政府負責郵政服務？
questions.explain_zh: 郵政服務和通信網絡由聯邦政府（Australian Government）負責，和税收、國防、移民一樣屬於全國性事務。

questions.question_en: What is the leader of the Australian Government called?
questions.gist_zh: 問：澳大利亞聯邦政府的首腦叫什麼？
questions.explain_zh: 聯邦政府的首腦是總理（Prime Minister）；州政府的首腦是 Premier。總督是國王的代表。

questions.question_en: What is it a crime even to offer a police officer?
questions.gist_zh: 問：向警察提供什麼，即使只是提出來，也是犯罪？
questions.explain_zh: 賄賂警察是嚴重的罪行，連提出要給警察賄賂（bribe）本身也是犯罪。

questions.question_en: What is a magistrate?
options_en: A judge of a lower court
A police officer in charge of a station
questions.gist_zh: 問：什麼是 magistrate？
questions.explain_zh: Magistrate 是下級法院的法官。法官和 magistrate 都獨立，政府不能因為不同意他們的判決而撤他們的職。

questions.question_en: Which national court did the Australian Constitution establish, along with Parliament?
options_en: The Supreme Court of New South Wales
questions.gist_zh: 問：憲法（Constitution）除了議會，還設立了哪個全國性法院？
questions.explain_zh: 憲法設立了聯邦議會和澳大利亞高等法院（High Court），高等法院有最終權力應用和解釋法律。

questions.question_en: A vote in which all voters decide on a change to the Constitution is called what?
questions.gist_zh: 問：全體選民對修改憲法投票叫什麼？
questions.explain_zh: 全體選民就修改憲法投票叫全民公決（referendum）。Election 是選出議員的選舉。

questions.question_en: Which body do the members of the Government come from?
questions.gist_zh: 問：聯邦政府（Government）的成員來自哪個機構？
questions.explain_zh: 政府由澳大利亞議會的議員組成，不來自法院或地方議會。

questions.question_en: What is a representative in a parliament?
options_en: Someone who writes new laws alone
Someone who speaks and acts for other people
A person who decides court cases
questions.gist_zh: 問：議會裏的 representative 是什麼人？
questions.explain_zh: Representative 是為他人説話、代表他人行事的人。議員代表選民，人民通過選舉選出他們。

questions.question_en: After an election, one party cannot govern alone. What can two parties with similar ideas do together?
options_en: Ask the High Court to choose a government
Join together to form a coalition
questions.gist_zh: 問：選舉後沒有政黨佔多數，兩個理念相近的政黨可以怎麼做？
questions.explain_zh: 兩個或多個政黨可以聯合組成聯盟（coalition），通常用來組建政府或反對黨。

questions.question_en: Who is elected by local voters to help run their local government area?
questions.gist_zh: 問：本地選民選出來、管理本地政府區域的人叫什麼？
questions.explain_zh: 地方議會選出的成員叫 councillor。參議員屬於聯邦議會，Premier 是州政府首腦。

questions.question_en: What are local councils responsible for?
options_en: Making laws for the whole country
Planning and delivering services to the community
questions.gist_zh: 問：地方議會（council）負責什麼？
questions.explain_zh: 地方議會負責規劃和提供本地社區的服務。制定全國性法律是聯邦議會的事。

questions.question_en: Besides a parliament, what else does every state government have for itself?
questions.gist_zh: 問：每個州政府除了有自己的議會，還有自己的什麼？
questions.explain_zh: 每個州政府都有自己的議會和憲法，運作方式與聯邦政府相似。每個州由一位 Governor 代表國王。

questions.heading: English as the national language
questions.question_en: An applicant for citizenship does not speak English as a first language. What must they undertake?
options_en: To pass a university English exam
To make reasonable efforts to learn it
To speak only English at home
questions.gist_zh: 問：如果英語不是母語，入籍申請人必須承諾什麼？
questions.explain_zh: 申請入籍的人必須承諾作出合理的努力學習英語，不需要考大學英語，也沒有説在家只能説英語。

questions.heading: English as the national language
questions.question_en: Which of these is NOT a reason given for learning English in Australia?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項不是書裏説的學英語的理由？（NOT = 不是）
questions.explain_zh: 學英語能幫助你接受教育、找工作，更好地融入社區。學英語不能用來避税。

questions.heading: Glossary of testable section
questions.question_en: What is mateship?
options_en: Joining a sports club to make new friends
Sharing the cost of a house with friends
Helping each other, especially in hard times
questions.gist_zh: 問：什麼是 mateship？
questions.explain_zh: Mateship 是互相幫助，特別是在困難的時候，例如車壞了別的司機幫忙推車。不是隻指一起打球或同住。

questions.heading: Compassion for those in need
questions.question_en: Which of these is NOT an example of compassion for those in need?
options_en: Charging a sick friend for a lift to hospital
Bringing food to an elderly neighbour
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項不是 compassion 的例子？（NOT = 不是）
questions.explain_zh: 給年長鄰居送飯、探望孤單的人，都是在困難中互相幫助的例子。向生病的朋友收搭車費不是。

questions.heading: Glossary of testable section
questions.question_en: What is a volunteer?
options_en: A person paid to guard a building
A person who gives their time without being paid
Someone who votes in every election
questions.gist_zh: 問：什麼是 volunteer？
questions.explain_zh: Volunteer 是不求報酬、願意付出時間的人，例如教人學英語的志願者。

questions.heading: Helping to keep our society safe
questions.question_en: A person sees a child being abused. What should they do?
options_en: Wait to see if it happens again
Talk to the child's school instead
questions.gist_zh: 問：看到孩子被虐待，應該怎麼辦？
questions.explain_zh: 如果看到或知道有孩子被虐待，應該向警察報告，讓警方調查。

questions.heading: Mutual respect and tolerance for others
questions.question_en: Which of these does the booklet say has no place in Australia?
options_en: Cheering loudly for the other team
Making racially abusive comments at a sporting event
Speaking your first language in public
questions.gist_zh: 問：書裏説下面哪一項在澳大利亞沒有立足之地？
questions.explain_zh: 在公共場所或體育賽事上發表帶種族侮辱的言論，屬於種族主義，在澳大利亞沒有立足之地。

questions.heading: Mutual respect and tolerance for others
questions.question_en: When should people show tolerance towards each other?
options_en: When they find that they disagree
When they share the same religion
When they live in the same suburb
questions.gist_zh: 問：人們什麼時候應該對彼此 tolerant？
questions.explain_zh: 在彼此意見不同的時候，也要互相寬容，傾聽並尊重對方的觀點。

questions.heading: Loyalty to Australia
questions.question_en: Which statement about dual citizenship is correct?
options_en: It is allowed only for people born overseas
It lets you ignore some Australian laws
It is allowed if the other country's laws allow it
questions.gist_zh: 問：關於 dual citizenship，哪句話是對的？
questions.explain_zh: 只要另一個國家的法律允許，澳大利亞公民可以同時持有別國國籍，這叫 dual 或 multiple citizenship。

questions.heading: Equality of all people under the law
questions.question_en: Which of these is NOT a personal matter both men and women can decide for themselves?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項不是男女都能自己決定的個人事務？（NOT = 不是）
questions.explain_zh: 男女都有權自己決定婚姻、宗教這類個人事務。適用哪些法律不能自己選，澳大利亞法律適用於所有人。

questions.heading: Commitment to the Rule of Law
questions.question_en: What happens to a person who does not obey the law in Australia?
options_en: They are given a second chance
They are asked to leave the country
questions.gist_zh: 問：在澳大利亞不遵守法律會怎樣？
questions.explain_zh: 人人都應該遵守法律，不遵守就會面臨處罰（penalties）。

questions.heading: Equality of opportunity and a 'fair go'
questions.question_en: In a society that values a 'fair go', which of these should NOT decide who gets a job?
questions.gist_zh: 問：重視 'fair go' 的社會裏，下面哪一項不應該決定誰得到工作？（NOT = 不應該）
questions.explain_zh: 找工作應該看技能和經驗，不是看性別、財富或族裔背景。

questions.heading: Freedom of religion
questions.question_en: What is polygamy?
options_en: Having more than one husband or wife at the same time
questions.gist_zh: 問：什麼是 polygamy？
questions.explain_zh: Polygamy 是同時有多個丈夫或妻子，在澳大利亞是違法的，可能被嚴厲處罰，包括坐牢。強迫婚姻則是另一回事。

questions.question_en: How do Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples express their deep connection with the land?
options_en: Through their stories, art and dance
questions.gist_zh: 問：原住民和托雷斯海峽島民通過什麼方式表達他們與土地的深厚聯繫？
questions.explain_zh: 他們與土地有很深的聯繫，這種聯繫體現在他們的故事、藝術和舞蹈中。

questions.question_en: About what share of Australia's population are Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples?
questions.gist_zh: 問：原住民和托雷斯海峽島民大約佔澳大利亞人口的多少？
questions.explain_zh: 他們大約佔澳大利亞人口的3%。注意是百分之三，不是百分之三十。

questions.question_en: How many ships were in the First Fleet?
questions.gist_zh: 問：First Fleet 一共有多少艘船？
questions.explain_zh: 第一批運送囚犯的船隊共有11艘船，1788年1月26日抵達澳大利亞。

questions.question_en: Where did the First Fleet land on 26 January 1788?
questions.gist_zh: 問：1788年1月26日，First Fleet 在哪裏登陸？
questions.explain_zh: 第一艦隊在悉尼灣（Sydney Cove）登陸，建立了新南威爾士的第一個殖民地。

questions.question_en: How many separate Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander languages does the booklet say are valued?
questions.gist_zh: 問：手冊説澳大利亞有多少種不同的原住民和托雷斯海峽島民語言受到重視？
questions.explain_zh: 手冊説，除了英語，還有100多種不同的原住民和托雷斯海峽島民語言同樣受到重視。

questions.question_en: About how many people lived in Australia in 1901, not counting Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples?
questions.gist_zh: 問：1901年澳大利亞大約有多少人（不包括原住民和托雷斯海峽島民）？
questions.explain_zh: 1901年澳大利亞人口約400萬。原住民要到1967年公投以後才被計入官方人口估算。

questions.question_en: People have come to Australia in recent years for all of these reasons EXCEPT…
questions.gist_zh: 問：近年來人們來澳大利亞的原因，下面哪一項不是？（EXCEPT = 除了）
questions.explain_zh: 近年來的移民和難民項目讓人們來澳大利亞團聚、開始新生活，或逃離貧困、戰爭和迫害。服刑是以前運送囚犯的歷史，不是近年移民的原因。

questions.question_en: Where is the Australian Capital Territory located?
questions.gist_zh: 問：澳大利亞首都領地（ACT）位於哪裏？
questions.explain_zh: 首都領地位於悉尼和墨爾本之間，首都堪培拉就在這裏。

questions.question_en: Which city is the largest in Australia?
questions.gist_zh: 問：澳大利亞最大的城市是哪一個？
questions.explain_zh: 悉尼是新南威爾士的首府，也是全國最大的城市。注意最大的城市不是首都；首都是堪培拉。

questions.question_en: Which is the second largest state in Australia?
questions.gist_zh: 問：澳大利亞第二大的州是哪一個？
questions.explain_zh: 昆士蘭是第二大的州；最大的是西澳大利亞，最小的是塔斯馬尼亞。

questions.question_en: Which strait separates Tasmania from the mainland?
questions.gist_zh: 問：哪個海峽把塔斯馬尼亞和大陸分開？
questions.explain_zh: 塔斯馬尼亞與大陸之間隔着巴斯海峽（Bass Strait）。托雷斯海峽在昆士蘭最北端附近，不要混淆。

questions.question_en: How many states and mainland territories does Australia have?
options_en: Six states and two mainland territories
Seven states and one mainland territory
Four states and four mainland territories
questions.gist_zh: 問：澳大利亞一共有幾個州和幾個大陸領地？
questions.explain_zh: 澳大利亞有6個州和2個大陸領地（首都領地和北領地）。

questions.question_en: How does the citizenship booklet describe Anzac Day?
options_en: A day of fireworks and parties
questions.gist_zh: 問：公民手冊怎樣形容 Anzac Day？
questions.explain_zh: Anzac Day 是莊重的紀念日，用來緬懷所有在戰爭、衝突和維和行動中服役和犧牲的澳大利亞人。宣佈年度澳大利亞人獎（Australian of the Year Awards）是在 Australia Day。

questions.question_en: Which public holiday is the largest each year across Australia?
questions.gist_zh: 問：澳大利亞一年中最大的公共假日是哪一天？
questions.explain_zh: Australia Day（1月26日）是全國最大的年度公共假日。

questions.question_en: Apart from the National Flag, which flags are officially recognised for flying in the community?
options_en: The Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander flags
The Union Jack and the Eureka flag
The flags of migrants' home countries
questions.gist_zh: 問：除了國旗，還有哪些旗幟是官方承認、可以在社區裏升掛的？
questions.explain_zh: 官方承認的除了國旗，還有澳大利亞原住民旗和托雷斯海峽島民旗。每個州和領地也有自己的旗。

questions.question_en: On the Australian Aboriginal Flag, what does the red half stand for?
questions.gist_zh: 問：澳大利亞原住民旗下半部的紅色代表什麼？
questions.explain_zh: 紅色代表大地，大地有儀式上的重要意義。黑色的上半部才代表原住民，黃色圓圈代表太陽。

questions.question_en: On the Torres Strait Islander Flag, what does the colour white symbolise?
questions.gist_zh: 問：托雷斯海峽島民旗上的白色象徵什麼？
questions.explain_zh: 白色象徵和平。綠色條紋代表土地，藍色代表海。

questions.question_en: Traditionally, why was a Welcome to Country performed?
options_en: To help visitors have a safe journey
questions.gist_zh: 問：傳統上為什麼要舉行 Welcome to Country？
questions.explain_zh: 傳統上，舉行這個儀式是為了讓訪客在這片土地上旅途平安、受到保護。

questions.question_en: Where are people in Australia free to meet for social or political discussion?
questions.gist_zh: 問：在澳大利亞，人們可以在哪裏聚會進行社交或政治討論？
questions.explain_zh: 人們可以在公共場所或私人場所聚會，討論社交或政治話題。

questions.question_en: Which of these is a legal group that people in Australia are free to join?
options_en: A group planning to use violence
A group that damages other people's property
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一個是澳大利亞人可以自由加入的合法組織？
questions.explain_zh: 人們可以自由加入任何合法組織，例如政黨、工會、宗教、文化或社交團體。違法的團體不在其中。

questions.question_en: A referendum is a vote to change what?
questions.gist_zh: 問：公民投票（referendum）是為了改變什麼？
questions.explain_zh: Referendum 是投票決定是否修改澳大利亞憲法（Constitution）。

questions.question_en: What is a jury?
options_en: Everyday Australians who hear the evidence and decide if someone broke the law
Government lawyers who argue the case against the person
Police officers who arrested the person and report to the judge
questions.gist_zh: 問：jury 是什麼？
questions.explain_zh: 陪審團由普通的澳大利亞男女組成，聽取法庭上的證據，然後決定被告有罪還是無罪。

questions.question_en: Which of these is paid for with taxes?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項是用税款支付的？
questions.explain_zh: 税款用於政府資助的醫療和教育、國防、公路和鐵路、社會保障等服務。

questions.question_en: Voting is a responsibility and a right for citizens aged 18 or over. What else does the booklet call it?
questions.gist_zh: 問：年滿18歲的公民投票既是責任也是權利，手冊還把它稱為什麼？
questions.explain_zh: 手冊説投票是重要的責任、權利和特權（privilege）。在聯邦和州選舉中投票是強制的，不是可選的。

questions.question_en: To vote, citizens aged 18 or over must first enrol for which of these?
options_en: Federal, state and territory elections plus referenda
Local council elections in every state
Federal elections, but not state or territory ones
questions.gist_zh: 問：年滿18歲的公民必須登記（enrol）才能參加哪些投票？
questions.explain_zh: 公民必須登記，才能參加聯邦、州和領地的選舉以及憲法修改的公投。沒有正確登記就不能投票。

questions.question_en: Which of these is one of the liberties that Australians value in a democratic society?
options_en: Freedom to choose which laws to obey
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項是澳大利亞人在民主社會中重視的自由之一？
questions.explain_zh: 手冊列出的自由包括言論自由、表達自由、宗教自由和結社自由。選擇遵守哪些法律、不用投票都不是自由的一部分。

questions.question_en: What does the Australian Human Rights Commission do?
options_en: It looks into complaints about unfair treatment and human rights abuses
It decides who wins federal elections each time
It runs the courts that sentence people who break the law
questions.gist_zh: 問：Australian Human Rights Commission 是做什麼的？
questions.explain_zh: 這是一個獨立機構，調查歧視和侵犯人權的投訴。遇到種族歧視等情況可以向它投訴。選舉由選舉委員會負責，審判由法院負責。

questions.question_en: Which of these is an example of a place where Australian Public Service staff work?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一個是澳大利亞公共服務系統（Public Service）工作單位的例子？
questions.explain_zh: 聯邦政府的公共服務單位包括 Services Australia 和税務局（ATO）。州醫院和地方議會屬於州或地方政府。

questions.question_en: Besides the Australian Government, which governments also collect taxes?
options_en: Community groups that run local events
The state and territory governments, and councils
questions.gist_zh: 問：除了聯邦政府，還有哪些政府也收税？
questions.explain_zh: 州和領地政府以及地方議會也收税，用來支付它們提供的服務。

questions.question_en: How does jury service help the court system?
options_en: It lets lawyers decide every case
It helps make the system open and fair
It lets the government choose the verdicts
questions.gist_zh: 問：擔任陪審員對法院制度有什麼幫助？
questions.explain_zh: 陪審員服務有助於確保法院制度公開、公平。判決不是由政府或律師決定的。

questions.question_en: Which of these is a public holiday in Australia on a Christian day?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一個是澳大利亞基督教節日的公共假日？
questions.explain_zh: 澳大利亞有基督教節日的公共假日，例如 Good Friday、Easter Sunday 和 Christmas Day。Australia Day 和 Anzac Day 不是基督教節日。

questions.question_en: In which of these situations can an Australian official overseas give a citizen advice and support?
options_en: When the citizen needs a local driver's licence
When the citizen wants a job in another country
After a serious accident or illness
questions.gist_zh: 問：在下面哪種情況下，海外的澳大利亞官員可以給公民提供建議和支持？
questions.explain_zh: 官員可以在事故、重病或死亡等情況下給公民建議和支持，也可以幫助辦理緊急護照。辦當地駕照或找工作不在其內。

questions.question_en: Which of these is NOT a privilege of Australian citizenship?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項不是澳大利亞公民的特權？（NOT = 不是）
questions.explain_zh: 擔任陪審員屬於公民的責任。申請澳大利亞護照和在海外尋求領事協助是特權。

questions.question_en: Which of these can a person NOT be forced to do in Australia?
options_en: Pay tax on money they earn
questions.gist_zh: 問：在澳大利亞，下面哪一件事是不能強迫別人去做的？（NOT = 不能）
questions.explain_zh: 人們可以自由決定不加入某個組織，不能被強迫加入。但遵守法律和依法納税是每個人都必須做的。

questions.question_en: Which statement about voting in Australia is incorrect?
options_en: Voting is compulsory in federal elections
Citizens must be at least 21 to vote
Voters need to be correctly enrolled
questions.gist_zh: 問：關於澳大利亞的投票，下面哪一項説法是錯誤的？（incorrect = 錯誤）
questions.explain_zh: 公民年滿18歲就有投票的責任，不是21歲。聯邦選舉投票是強制的，而且必須正確登記才能投票。

questions.question_en: Which statement about Australian citizens travelling overseas is incorrect?
options_en: They can ask an Australian official for help in an emergency
They can return to Australia without needing a visa
They do not have to obey the laws of the country they visit
questions.gist_zh: 問：關於澳大利亞公民在海外旅行，下面哪一項説法是錯誤的？（incorrect = 錯誤）
questions.explain_zh: 在其他國家，公民必須遵守當地的法律。公民可以在緊急情況下向澳大利亞官員求助，回澳大利亞也不需要簽證。

questions.question_en: Which statement about religion in Australia is incorrect?
options_en: Australian law prevails over a conflicting religious practice
All citizens are treated equally by the government, whatever their beliefs
Everyone must follow the official national religion
questions.gist_zh: 問：關於澳大利亞的宗教，下面哪一項説法是錯誤的？（incorrect = 錯誤）
questions.explain_zh: 澳大利亞沒有官方的國教，人們可以自由選擇信仰。法律和宗教習俗衝突時，以澳大利亞法律為準。

questions.question_en: A citizen thinks a law needs to be changed. What can the citizen do?
options_en: Write to a judge about the law
Ask the Governor-General to sign a new Bill
questions.gist_zh: 問：一位公民認為某條法律需要修改，他可以怎麼做？
questions.explain_zh: 公民可以聯繫自己選出的代表，反映對政府政策的意見。代表應該考慮公民提出的建議。

questions.question_en: Why is the Australian Electoral Commission described as independent?
options_en: Its members are chosen by the Prime Minister each year
Political parties and people in government cannot influence its decisions
It is run by the party that forms the government
questions.gist_zh: 問：為什麼説澳大利亞選舉委員會（AEC）是獨立的？
questions.explain_zh: 政黨和政府裏的人不能影響選舉委員會的決定，所以它是獨立於政府的。

questions.question_en: Before 1901, every British colony in Australia had its own constitution and laws. How many separate colonies were there?
questions.gist_zh: 問：1901年以前，各個英國殖民地各有自己的憲法和法律。當時一共有幾個殖民地？
questions.explain_zh: 1901年以前，澳大利亞由六個各自管理的英國殖民地組成。1901年1月1日它們聯合成一個國家。

questions.question_en: The Australian Constitution began as part of a British law. In which year was it passed?
questions.gist_zh: 問：澳大利亞憲法最初作為英國法律的一部分，是哪一年通過的？
questions.explain_zh: 憲法1900年作為英國一項法案的一部分通過，1901年1月1日生效。1788年是第一艦隊抵達，1967年是公投。

questions.question_en: Who is responsible for government departments?
questions.gist_zh: 問：政府各個部門由誰負責？
questions.explain_zh: 部長（ministers）負責政府部門。法官屬於司法權，地方議員屬於地方政府。

questions.question_en: How does the Governor-General act towards political parties?
options_en: On behalf of the governing party
questions.gist_zh: 問：總督（Governor-General）對各個政黨的態度是怎樣的？
questions.explain_zh: 總督不屬於政府，必須保持中立，獨立於所有政黨行事。

questions.question_en: Why are the King's powers delegated to the Governor-General?
options_en: The King may not make any decisions
The Governor-General is elected by voters
questions.gist_zh: 問：為什麼國王的權力要交給總督？
questions.explain_zh: 國王不住在澳大利亞，所以他的權力委託給在澳大利亞的總督。總督是國王根據總理的建議任命的，不是選民選出的。

questions.question_en: Who starts the process for a federal election?
questions.gist_zh: 問：聯邦選舉的程序由誰啓動？
questions.explain_zh: 啓動聯邦選舉程序是總督的職責之一。總督還簽署法案、履行禮儀職責、批准政府和部長的任命。

questions.question_en: The Governor-General's role includes all of these EXCEPT…
questions.gist_zh: 問：總督的職責包括下面所有各項，除了哪一項？（EXCEPT = 除了）
questions.explain_zh: 總督簽署國會通過的法案、履行禮儀職責，但不在國會裏寫新法律；立法是國會的權力。

questions.question_en: Whom does a senator represent?
questions.gist_zh: 問：參議員（senator）代表誰？
questions.explain_zh: 參議員是代表一個州或領地的民選代表。代表選區的是眾議院議員（MP）。

questions.question_en: A government minister is a Member of Parliament chosen by whom?
questions.gist_zh: 問：政府部長是由誰挑選出來的國會議員？
questions.explain_zh: 部長是由政府領導人挑選、負責某個政府領域的國會議員。

questions.question_en: What is the area of government that a minister is responsible for called?
questions.gist_zh: 問：部長負責的政府領域叫什麼？
questions.explain_zh: 部長負責的領域叫 portfolio，例如就業、原住民事務或財政部。最重要的 portfolio 的部長組成內閣。

questions.question_en: Which of these is NOT a main political party in Australia?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一個不是澳大利亞的主要政黨？（NOT = 不是）
questions.explain_zh: 主要政黨有自由黨、工黨、國家黨和綠黨。不屬於任何政黨的議員叫 independents，他們不是一個政黨。

questions.question_en: Which statement about joining a political party is correct?
options_en: Government members are the ones allowed to join
Citizens must join a party in order to vote
People are free to join one if they choose
questions.gist_zh: 問：關於加入政黨，下面哪一項説法是正確的？
questions.explain_zh: 在澳大利亞，人們可以自由選擇是否加入政黨。投票並不要求加入任何政黨。

questions.question_en: Which body makes the laws for a state?
questions.gist_zh: 問：州的法律由哪個機構制定？
questions.explain_zh: 州和領地的議會用與聯邦議會類似的方式制定自己的法律。

questions.question_en: Which of these is a role of the House of Representatives?
options_en: To discuss and vote on suggested new laws
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項是眾議院的職責？
questions.explain_zh: 眾議院的職責是審議、辯論並表決新法律或修改法律的提案，也討論國家重要事務。審案是法院的事。

questions.question_en: Which of these has rights recognised by the Constitution?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一個擁有憲法承認的權利？
questions.explain_zh: 憲法承認州的權利，領地沒有。自治領地的法律可以隨時被聯邦政府修改或廢除。

questions.question_en: Where are state and territory governments based?
questions.gist_zh: 問：州和領地政府設在哪裏？
questions.explain_zh: 州和領地政府設在各自的首府城市，不是在堪培拉。

questions.question_en: Which of these is NOT a name for a local government area?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一個不是地方政府轄區的名稱？（NOT = 不是）
questions.explain_zh: 地方政府轄區可以叫 city、shire、town 或 municipality。division 是眾議院選區的另一種叫法。

questions.question_en: Which level of government is responsible for immigration and citizenship?
questions.gist_zh: 問：移民和公民身份由哪一級政府負責？
questions.explain_zh: 移民和公民身份由澳大利亞聯邦政府負責。

questions.question_en: Which level of government is mainly responsible for police and ambulance services?
questions.gist_zh: 問：警察和救護服務主要由哪一級政府負責？
questions.explain_zh: 警察和救護服務主要由州和領地政府負責。

questions.question_en: Which level of government deals with noise and animal control?
questions.gist_zh: 問：噪音和動物管理由哪一級政府負責？
questions.explain_zh: 噪音和動物管理屬於地方政府的責任，還有垃圾收集、公園和圖書館等。

questions.question_en: Pensions and family support are part of which area of Australian Government responsibility?
questions.gist_zh: 問：養老金和家庭補助屬於聯邦政府哪個方面的責任？
questions.explain_zh: 養老金和家庭補助屬於聯邦政府負責的社會保障（social security）。

questions.question_en: Which of these is NOT mainly a responsibility of state and territory governments?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項主要不是州和領地政府的責任？（NOT = 不是）
questions.explain_zh: 貿易和商業由聯邦政府負責。公共交通、醫院和健康服務主要由州和領地政府負責。

questions.question_en: Besides local governments, which government is also responsible for street signs and parks?
questions.gist_zh: 問：除了地方政府，還有哪個政府也負責路牌和公園？
questions.explain_zh: 首都領地（ACT）政府也負責地方政府那類事務，如路牌、交通控制、公園等。

questions.question_en: Who must wear a seatbelt when travelling in a car in Australia?
options_en: Only passengers in the front seat
questions.gist_zh: 問：在澳大利亞乘坐汽車，誰必須系安全帶？
questions.explain_zh: 車上所有的人都必須系安全帶，嬰兒和幼兒要坐經批准的安全座椅。交通規則由州和領地政府管理。

questions.question_en: Which of these is against the law when driving in Australia?
questions.gist_zh: 問：在澳大利亞開車時，下面哪一種做法是違法的？
questions.explain_zh: 開車時使用手持移動設備是違法的。開車需要當地駕照，車也必須登記，這些都是合法要求。

questions.question_en: What can happen to people who break traffic laws in Australia?
options_en: Nothing, because traffic rules are only advice
They lose their right to vote
They may be fined, or even jailed
questions.gist_zh: 問：在澳大利亞違反交通法規，可能會有什麼後果？
questions.explain_zh: 交通法規很嚴格，違規者可能被罰款，甚至被判入獄。

questions.question_en: Which of these is one of the most serious crimes in Australia?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項屬於澳大利亞最嚴重的罪行之一？
questions.explain_zh: 手冊列出的嚴重罪行包括謀殺、襲擊、持械搶劫、盜竊、欺詐、持有違禁毒品等。和平遊行和寫信給報社是合法的。

questions.question_en: Which statement about violence between spouses at home is correct?
options_en: It is a private family matter
It is illegal and a very serious crime
It is allowed between a husband and wife
questions.gist_zh: 問：關於夫妻之間在家裏的暴力，下面哪一項説法是正確的？
questions.explain_zh: 在澳大利亞，對他人使用暴力是非法的，是非常嚴重的罪行，家庭內部和婚姻內部的暴力也一樣。

questions.question_en: Domestic and family violence can include threatening whom?
questions.gist_zh: 問：家庭暴力可能包括威脅誰？
questions.explain_zh: 家庭暴力包括毆打、使家人與親友隔離，以及威脅孩子或寵物。目的是通過恐懼控制伴侶。

questions.question_en: Which police forces handle state and territory crimes?
options_en: The state and Northern Territory police forces
questions.gist_zh: 問：州和領地的犯罪由哪些警察負責？
questions.explain_zh: 各州和北領地有自己的警察，負責州和領地法律下的犯罪。聯邦警察負責聯邦法律下的犯罪。

questions.question_en: Which police force does the general police work in the ACT?
questions.gist_zh: 問：首都領地（ACT）的一般警務由哪個警察機構負責？
questions.explain_zh: 澳大利亞聯邦警察（AFP）也負責首都領地的一般警務工作。

questions.question_en: Who has the most authority in a court?
questions.gist_zh: 問：法庭裏最高的權威是誰？
questions.explain_zh: 法官或下級法院法官（magistrate）是法庭的最高權威，他們是獨立的，沒有人能告訴他們該怎麼判。

questions.question_en: How must babies and young children travel in a car in Australia?
options_en: In the front seat with a seatbelt
questions.gist_zh: 問：在澳大利亞，嬰兒和幼兒坐汽車必須怎樣？
questions.explain_zh: 嬰兒和幼兒必須坐在經批准的安全座椅裏；車上其他人都必須系安全帶。

questions.question_en: What does the judge do for the jury in a trial?
options_en: Gives evidence against the accused person
questions.gist_zh: 問：審判中，法官為陪審團做什麼？
questions.explain_zh: 法官向陪審團解釋法律；由陪審團決定被告是否有罪。刑事審判中如果陪審團裁定有罪，由法官決定刑罰。

questions.question_en: Which statement about juries is incorrect?
options_en: A jury decides whether a person is innocent or guilty
questions.gist_zh: 問：關於陪審團，下面哪一項説法是錯誤的？（incorrect = 錯誤）
questions.explain_zh: 陪審員是從普通人羣中隨機選出的公民，不是政府任命的。陪審團的任務是決定被告無罪還是有罪。

questions.question_en: What does the electoral roll list?
options_en: The people who have served on a jury
questions.gist_zh: 問：electoral roll 上列的是什麼？
questions.explain_zh: 選民名冊是已登記可以在選舉或公投中投票的人的名單。

questions.question_en: Which statement about voting in a referendum on changing the Constitution is correct?
options_en: Voting is optional for citizens aged 18 or over
Members of parliament vote on behalf of citizens
questions.gist_zh: 問：關於修改憲法的公投，下面哪一項説法是正確的？
questions.explain_zh: 在澳大利亞的選舉和憲法修改的公投中，投票是強制的。

questions.question_en: What does it mean to 'enforce the law'?
options_en: To make sure people follow it
To change a law by referendum
questions.gist_zh: 問："enforce the law"是什麼意思？
questions.explain_zh: Enforce the law 就是確保人們遵守法律，例如警察執行法律、維持治安。

questions.question_en: What happens at a criminal trial?
options_en: A court hears the facts and rules on whether someone is guilty
A minister decides the penalty without a trial
A Bill is signed into law by the Governor-General
questions.gist_zh: 問：刑事審判（criminal trial）上會發生什麼？
questions.explain_zh: 刑事審判是法庭審理事實，決定被告有罪還是無罪的聽證會。

questions.question_en: Which of these is NOT a job of the courts?
options_en: Arresting people who may have broken the law
Deciding the penalty for a crime
Deciding whether someone has broken the law
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項不是法院的工作？（NOT = 不是）
questions.explain_zh: 法院決定一個人有沒有違法，並決定刑罰。逮捕嫌疑人是警察的工作。

questions.question_en: Which statement about the police is incorrect?
options_en: They can arrest someone they believe has broken the law
They are independent of the government
They decide whether a person is guilty
questions.gist_zh: 問：關於警察，下面哪一項説法是錯誤的？（incorrect = 錯誤）
questions.explain_zh: 警察可以在法庭上提供證據，但是否有罪由法院決定。警察可以逮捕他們認為違法的人，也獨立於政府。

questions.question_en: Which of these is NOT another name for the Senate?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一個不是參議院（Senate）的別名？（NOT = 不是）
questions.explain_zh: 參議院也叫 Upper House、House of Review 或 States' House。People's House 是眾議院的別名。

questions.question_en: Which statement about the Governor-General is incorrect?
options_en: The Governor-General signs Bills into law
The Governor-General approves who becomes a minister
The Governor-General belongs to the governing party
questions.gist_zh: 問：關於總督，下面哪一項説法是錯誤的？（incorrect = 錯誤）
questions.explain_zh: 總督不屬於政府，必須保持中立。總督簽署國會通過的法案，也批准政府和部長的任命。

questions.heading: Australian values
questions.question_en: What are all people in Australia expected to do with Australian values?
questions.gist_zh: 問：所有生活在澳大利亞的人對澳大利亞價值觀應該怎麼做？
questions.explain_zh: 手冊説，所有澳大利亞人都應該尊重、認同並維護這些價值觀。

questions.heading: Freedom of religion
questions.question_en: What legal status do religious laws have in Australia?
options_en: They apply to followers of that religion
They override Australian law in family matters
None; everyone must follow Australian law
questions.gist_zh: 問：宗教法律在澳大利亞有什麼法律地位？
questions.explain_zh: 宗教法律在澳大利亞沒有法律地位。每個人都必須遵守澳大利亞法律，即使它與宗教法律不同。

questions.heading: Freedom of religion
questions.question_en: Under Australian law, what can forced marriage result in?
questions.gist_zh: 問：根據澳大利亞法律，強迫婚姻（forced marriage）可能導致什麼後果？
questions.explain_zh: 強迫婚姻在澳大利亞是違法的，可能導致嚴厲的法律處罰，包括坐牢。

questions.heading: Equality of all people under the law
questions.question_en: A woman has better qualifications and skills than a man for a job. What is correct in Australia?
options_en: The man must be offered the job first
It is her right to get the job ahead of him
The employer should choose by gender
questions.gist_zh: 問：一位女性的資歷和技能比一位男性更好，兩人申請同一份工作。在澳大利亞，下面哪種説法是正確的？
questions.explain_zh: 在澳大利亞，如果女性的資歷和技能更好，她有權比男性優先得到這份工作。按性別歧視是違法的。

questions.question_en: Which kind of crime does the Australian Federal Police investigate?
questions.gist_zh: 問：澳大利亞聯邦警察（AFP）調查哪一類犯罪？
questions.explain_zh: 聯邦警察調查違反聯邦法律的犯罪，例如販毒、危害國家安全的罪行和危害環境的罪行。州警察處理州和領地法律下的犯罪。

questions.heading: Mutual respect and tolerance for others
questions.question_en: Under Australian law, sexual relations with someone below the age of consent are…
options_en: against the law in every state and territory
allowed if the couple plan to marry
questions.gist_zh: 問：根據澳大利亞法律，與未達法定同意年齡的人發生性關係是什麼性質的？
questions.explain_zh: 法定性同意年齡是16或17歲，各州和領地不同。與低於這個年齡的人發生性關係，在所有州和領地都是違法的，家人同意也沒用。

questions.heading: Mutual respect and tolerance for others
questions.question_en: A police officer makes a lawful request. What should you do?
options_en: Ignore it if you disagree with the officer
Ask the officer to put the request in writing
Obey it, because Australians follow the law
questions.gist_zh: 問：警察提出了一個合法的要求，你應該怎麼做？
questions.explain_zh: 應當支持警察依法採取的行動，並服從警察合法的要求，因為所有澳大利亞人都承諾遵守法律。

questions.heading: Helping to keep our society safe
questions.question_en: Which of these is an example of cyber abuse?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項是網絡欺凌/網絡濫用（cyber abuse）的例子？
questions.explain_zh: 網絡濫用的例子包括未經同意在網上分享性照片或視頻、在網上跟蹤騷擾他人，以及發表帶種族辱罵的言論。很多形式在澳大利亞是違法的。

questions.heading: Compassion for those in need
questions.question_en: Which of these is a benefit of volunteering?
options_en: Learning new skills and feeling you belong
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項是做志願者的好處？
questions.explain_zh: 做志願者可以分享知識、學習新技能，並增強融入社區的歸屬感。志願者做事不求報酬。

questions.heading: Loyalty to Australia
questions.question_en: Which of these would undermine Australia's interests and security?
options_en: Sharing official government secrets on social media
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一種做法會損害澳大利亞的利益和安全？
questions.explain_zh: 用社交媒體分享政府的官方機密，就是損害澳大利亞的利益。投票和學英語都是公民應有的行為。

questions.heading: Equality of opportunity and a 'fair go'
questions.question_en: According to the idea of a 'fair go', people should not be limited by what?
options_en: The suburb they choose to live in
questions.gist_zh: 問：按照 'fair go' 的理念，人們不應該被什麼限制？
questions.explain_zh: 'Fair go' 的意思是，人們不應該被任何階層的區分所限制，每個人都有平等的機會取得成功。

questions.heading: Mutual respect and tolerance for others
questions.question_en: Above all, Australians believe in the right to be what?
options_en: Safe and free from violence or intimidation
Free to settle disagreements by force
questions.gist_zh: 問：澳大利亞人最看重的是享有什麼樣的權利？
questions.explain_zh: 澳大利亞人相信和平地表達不同意見，最重要的是有權保持安全，不受暴力和恐嚇。

questions.question_en: Which of these is a democratic way to try to change a law?
options_en: Ignoring the law until it changes
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一種是通過民主方式爭取改變法律的做法？
questions.explain_zh: 人們可以通過討論、和平説服和民主程序，包括髮起運動要求修改法律，但必須始終遵守澳大利亞法律。威脅或無視法律都不行。

questions.heading: Freedom of religion
questions.question_en: Which of these is NOT against the law in Australia?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項在澳大利亞不違法？（NOT = 不）
questions.explain_zh: 離婚在澳大利亞是可以接受的。強迫婚姻和一夫多妻/一妻多夫都違法，可能被嚴厲處罰。

questions.heading: Loyalty to Australia
questions.question_en: Which of these would damage community relations in Australia?
options_en: Promoting distrust of an ethnic community
Donating money to a bushfire appeal
Volunteering to help at a local school
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一種做法會損害澳大利亞的社區關係？
questions.explain_zh: 宣揚對某個族裔社區的不信任和恐懼，會損害澳大利亞的社區關係。捐款救災和做志願者是互助的好例子。

questions.heading: Mutual respect and tolerance for others
questions.question_en: Which of these is NOT illegal in Australia?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項在澳大利亞不違法？（NOT = 不）
questions.explain_zh: 任何形式的暴力，包括言語辱罵和身體傷害，都是違法的。澳大利亞人相信和平地表達不同意見。

questions.heading: Australian values
questions.question_en: Which of these is NOT one of the ideas at the centre of Australian values?
questions.gist_zh: 問：下面哪一項不是澳大利亞價值觀的核心理念之一？（NOT = 不是）
questions.explain_zh: 澳大利亞價值觀以自由、尊重、公平和平等的機會為核心。出身帶來的特權不是其中之一。

questions.heading: Loyalty to Australia
questions.question_en: Which statement about dual citizenship is incorrect?
options_en: Holding two citizenships is called dual citizenship
A dual citizen in Australia must follow all Australian laws
Australian citizens may never hold another citizenship
questions.gist_zh: 問：關於雙重國籍，下面哪一項説法是錯誤的？（incorrect = 錯誤）
questions.explain_zh: 如果另一個國家的法律允許，澳大利亞公民也可以擁有別國國籍。無論是否有別國國籍，在澳大利亞都必須遵守所有澳大利亞法律。

options_zh: 哪個不是澳大利亞的州

drills.question_en: Which of these is NOT an Australian state?
drills.tip_zh: 先找題目裏的 NOT。NOT = 不是。
drills.explain_zh: 題目有 NOT，要選“不是州”的那一個。昆士蘭和塔斯馬尼亞都是州；北領地（Northern Territory）是領地，不是州。澳大利亞有六個州和兩個大陸領地。

twin.question_en: Which of these IS an Australian state?
twin.explain_zh: 沒有 NOT，答案就反過來，要選“是州”的那個。南澳大利亞是州；北領地和首都領地都是領地。

options_zh: 哪個是公民必須做的事
哪個不是公民必須做的事

drills.question_en: Which of these is NOT a responsibility of Australian citizens?
options_en: Serving on a jury if called
drills.tip_zh: NOT 在題目中間也要看到。responsibility = 責任（必須做的事）。
drills.explain_zh: NOT → 選“不是公民責任”的那個。守法、被召集時當陪審員都是公民的責任。加入政黨是一種自由：可以加入，也可以不加入，不是責任。

twin.question_en: Which of these IS a responsibility of Australian citizens?
twin.explain_zh: 這次沒有 NOT，選“是責任”的那個：投票。申請護照是公民的特權（privilege）：可以做，但不是必須做。

options_zh: 哪個顏色在原住民旗上
哪個顏色不在原住民旗上

drills.question_en: Which colour is NOT on the Australian Aboriginal Flag?
drills.tip_zh: NOT 讓你找“沒有的”那個。
drills.explain_zh: 原住民旗是黑、紅、黃三種顏色，沒有藍色。題目有 NOT，所以選藍色。

twin.question_en: Which colour IS on the Australian Aboriginal Flag?
twin.explain_zh: 紅色在原住民旗的下半部分，代表大地。綠色和藍色在托雷斯海峽島民旗上。

options_zh: 哪一項不是聯邦政府管的

drills.question_en: The Australian Government is responsible for all of these EXCEPT:
drills.tip_zh: EXCEPT 常在句子最後。EXCEPT = 除了。
drills.explain_zh: EXCEPT = 除了。要選出“不是聯邦政府管”的那一項：收垃圾是地方政府（市政府）管的。國防和移民入籍都由聯邦政府負責。

twin.question_en: Which of these is the Australian Government responsible for?
twin.explain_zh: 沒有 EXCEPT，就直接選聯邦政府管的：國防。收垃圾和社區圖書館是地方政府的事。

options_zh: 哪個是澳大利亞人享有的自由
哪個不是澳大利亞人享有的自由

drills.question_en: People in Australia have all of these freedoms EXCEPT:
options_en: Freedom to break the law for religious reasons
drills.tip_zh: EXCEPT 要選“不屬於”的那一個。
drills.explain_zh: 言論自由和宗教自由都有。但宗教活動也必須守法；法律和宗教做法有衝突時，以澳大利亞法律為準。所以“因為宗教而違法”不是一種自由。

decode.prompt_zh: “Which of the following…” 是什麼意思？
options_zh: 下面這些選項裏，哪一個……

drills.question_en: Which of the following is Australia's national flower?
drills.tip_zh: following = 下面的（選項），不是“跟隨”。
drills.explain_zh: Which of the following = 下面哪一個。澳大利亞國花是金合歡（golden wattle），國家代表色綠色和金色就來自它。

options_zh: 選出説法正確的那一句
選出説法錯誤的那一句

drills.question_en: Which statement is correct?
options_en: Australia has an official national religion.
Australia's government is separate from religion.
Religious laws are above Australian law.
drills.tip_zh: statement = 説法、一句話，不是“賬單”。
drills.explain_zh: 三句話裏只有 b 對：澳大利亞政府和宗教是分開的（secular，世俗）。澳大利亞沒有國教，宗教法律也不高於國家法律。

options_en: There is no state religion in Australia.
Religious laws are above Australian law.
When a religious practice conflicts with Australian law, the law comes first.
twin.explain_zh: 加了 NOT，就要選錯誤的那一句：c 是錯的。a 和 b 都是對的。

drills.question_en: Which statement is false?
options_en: Sydney is the capital of New South Wales.
Melbourne is the capital of Queensland.
Perth is the capital of Western Australia.
drills.tip_zh: false = 錯誤的。true = 對的。
drills.explain_zh: false = 錯誤的。墨爾本是維多利亞州的首府，昆士蘭州的首府是布里斯班，所以 c 是錯的。

options_en: Melbourne is the capital city of Queensland.
Darwin is the capital city of South Australia.
Hobart is the capital city of Tasmania.
twin.explain_zh: true = 對的。霍巴特是塔斯馬尼亞州首府。達爾文是北領地首府；南澳的首府是阿德萊德。

options_zh: 選出關於參議院的正確説法
選出關於參議院的錯誤説法

drills.question_en: Which statement about the Senate is incorrect?
options_en: Another name for the Senate is the Upper House.
States with more people elect more senators.
drills.tip_zh: in-、un- 會把意思反過來：correct → incorrect，true → untrue。
drills.explain_zh: incorrect = 不對的。各州不論人口多少，參議員人數都一樣（每州 12 名），所以 c 不對。

options_zh: 公民可以自己選擇做不做的事

drills.question_en: Which of these must Australian citizens do?
options_en: Serve on a jury if called
drills.tip_zh: must = 必須，沒有選擇。
drills.explain_zh: must = 必須。被召集當陪審員是公民的責任，一定要去。加入工會、做義工都是自願的，社會鼓勵但不強制。

options_zh: 公民可以選擇做、但不是必須做的事

drills.question_en: Which of these can Australian citizens choose to do, but do not have to do?
drills.tip_zh: can = 可以（被允許，但不是必須）。must = 必須。
drills.explain_zh: can = 可以做，但不是必須。申請護照是公民的特權（privilege），想申請才申請。守法和投票是公民必須做的（must），不能選擇不做。

decode.prompt_zh: 這裏的 may 是什麼意思？

drills.question_en: Ming broke a law, but he did not know the law existed. He may:
drills.tip_zh: may 有兩個意思：可以 / 可能會。看上下文。
drills.explain_zh: 這裏 may = 可能會。不知道法律不是藉口：就算你不知道有這條法律，違反了也可能被起訴。

drills.question_en: Your neighbour often plays very loud music late at night. What should you do?
options_en: Talk to them politely, or contact the local council
drills.tip_zh: should = 應該。選最守法、最尊重他人、最和平的做法。
drills.explain_zh: What should you do? = 你應該怎麼做？地方政府負責管噪音，可以先禮貌溝通或聯繫市政府。自己動手斷電、威脅或辱罵別人都不對；言語暴力在澳大利亞是違法的。

drills.question_en: Which of these must drivers in Australia NOT do?
options_en: Use a hand-held mobile phone while driving
drills.tip_zh: must not = 禁止。do not have to = 不必。
drills.explain_zh: must not = 禁止做。開車時手持手機是違法的。系安全帶、持有本地駕照都是必須做的。

drills.question_en: Which of these do people in Australia NOT have to do?
options_en: Pay tax when the law requires it
drills.tip_zh: do not have to = 不必，可以不做。它不是“禁止”。
drills.explain_zh: do not have to = 可以不做。在澳大利亞可以信任何宗教，也可以不信宗教。守法、按法律交税都是必須的。

decode.prompt_zh: 下面哪個説法的意思是“可以不做，但想做也可以”？

drills.question_en: Nobody is forced to join the Australian Defence Force. This means Australian citizens:
options_en: do not have to join the Defence Force
must join the Defence Force at age 18
must not join the Defence Force
drills.tip_zh: nobody is forced = 沒有人被強迫，也就是自願（voluntary）。
drills.explain_zh: 沒人被強迫 = 自願，所以是 do not have to（不必參加）。must not 是“禁止參加”，不對：公民有權申請加入國防軍。不過在國家需要時保衞澳大利亞，仍然是公民的責任。

drills.question_en: Which of these are people in Australia allowed to do?
options_en: Protest peacefully against a government decision
Force someone to join a group
drills.tip_zh: allowed to = 被允許。not allowed to = 不準。
drills.explain_zh: allowed to = 被允許。和平抗議是允許的。抗議時破壞財物、強迫別人加入團體都不允許。

twin.question_en: Which of these are people in Australia NOT allowed to do?
twin.explain_zh: 加了 NOT，就選“不準做的”：抗議時破壞財物是違法的。加入工會、批評政府都是允許的。

drills.question_en: Which of these are you required to do by law?
drills.tip_zh: required = 必須。不要和 request（請求）搞混。
drills.explain_zh: required to = 被要求（必須做）。交税是法律要求的。做義工、參加體育俱樂部都是自願的。

decode.prompt_zh: 選項裏的 only 是什麼意思？

drills.question_en: Which statement is correct?
options_en: Both men and women can vote and stand for parliament.
Only men can stand for parliament.
Only Christians are treated equally under the law.
drills.tip_zh: 看到 only 要特別小心：它把範圍限死了。
drills.explain_zh: only = 只有。a 和 b 用 only 把範圍限死了，和事實不符：男女都可以投票、參選議員；所有宗教的人在法律面前都一樣平等。

decode.prompt_zh: 選項裏的 never 是什麼意思？

drills.question_en: Which statement is correct?
options_en: Peaceful protests are never allowed in Australia.
Religious laws always come before Australian law.
Hurting your husband, wife or partner is never OK in Australia.
drills.tip_zh: always / never 是絕對詞，常常是錯的，但不一定錯。按事實判斷。
drills.explain_zh: 這一題裏帶 never 的 a 是對的：對配偶或伴侶使用暴力永遠不可接受，而且是犯罪。b 和 c 也有絕對詞，但都是錯的：和平抗議是允許的；澳大利亞法律高於宗教法律。

decode.prompt_zh: 這裏的 any 是什麼意思？

drills.question_en: In Australia you can join any group that obeys the law. This means you can join:
options_en: a political party, a union or a religious group, if you want to
only one group in your whole life
only groups the government chooses for you
drills.tip_zh: all = 全部，some = 一些，any = 任何一個。
drills.explain_zh: any = 任何一個（只要合法）。所以政黨、工會、宗教團體都可以加入，也可以選擇不加入。

options_zh: 哪一級政府最有責任感

drills.question_en: Which level of government is mainly responsible for hospitals and health services?
drills.tip_zh: responsible for = 負責管，不是“有責任感”。
drills.explain_zh: responsible for = 負責管。醫院和衞生服務主要由州和領地政府負責。

twin.question_en: Which level of government is responsible for building permits?
twin.explain_zh: 建築許可（building permits）由地方政府（市政府）負責。

options_zh: 陪審團的職責（工作）是什麼
陪審團在電影裏扮演什麼角色

drills.question_en: What is the role of a jury?
options_en: To decide whether someone broke the law
drills.tip_zh: role = 職責、作用，不是“演角色”。
drills.explain_zh: role = 職責。陪審團在法庭上判斷一個人是否有罪。制定法律是議會的事，逮捕人是警察的事。

options_zh: 誰在議會裏代表黃色圓圈

drills.question_en: What does the yellow circle on the Australian Aboriginal Flag represent?
drills.tip_zh: 旗幟題裏 represent = 象徵；議會題裏 represent = 代表（選民）。
drills.explain_zh: 在旗幟題裏 represent = 象徵。黃色圓圈代表太陽。海洋是托雷斯海峽島民旗上的藍色；和平是那面旗上的白色。

twin.question_en: Who represents the people of an electorate in the House of Representatives?
twin.explain_zh: 在議會題裏 represent = 代表（選民）。一個選區的人由一名眾議員（MP）代表。

drills.question_en: The House of Representatives is also known as:
drills.tip_zh: known as = 被叫做，不是“知道”。
drills.explain_zh: known as = 被稱為。眾議院也叫下議院（Lower House）或人民院（People's House）。Upper House（上議院）是參議院。

twin.question_en: The Senate is also known as:
twin.explain_zh: 參議院也叫上議院（Upper House）。人民院（People's House）是眾議院的另一個名字。

options_zh: 做什麼事要參考 Royal Assent

drills.question_en: What does 'Royal Assent' refer to?
options_en: The Governor-General approving a Bill to make it a law
The King choosing the Prime Minister
The people voting on the Constitution
drills.tip_zh: refer to = 指的是，不是“參考”。
drills.explain_zh: refer to = 指的是。Royal Assent（御準）指總督簽署議會通過的法案，讓它成為法律。修改憲法的投票叫全民公投（referendum）。

options_zh: 結社自由是誰提出來的
哪一個是“結社自由”的具體例子

drills.question_en: Which is an example of freedom of association?
drills.tip_zh: an example of = ……的一個例子。選符合定義的具體情況。
drills.explain_zh: 結社自由（freedom of association）= 可以自由組成或加入團體。加入工會就是一個例子。交税、考駕照和結社自由無關。

options_zh: 根據法治原則，誰必須守法

drills.question_en: Under the Rule of Law, who has to obey Australia's laws?
options_en: Only people who do not hold power
Everyone, including police and government leaders
drills.tip_zh: under the law / the Constitution = 根據法律 / 憲法，不是“在下面”。
drills.explain_zh: under = 根據。根據法治（Rule of Law），沒有人高於法律：警察、政府領導、宗教領袖、商人，每個人都要守法。

drills.question_en: Which of these is against the law in Australia?
options_en: Offering a bribe to a police officer
drills.tip_zh: against the law = illegal = unlawful = 違法。
drills.explain_zh: against the law = 違法。向警察行賄是犯罪，連“提出”給錢也是。不信宗教、批評政府都是合法的。

twin.question_en: Which of these is lawful in Australia?
options_en: Having two wives at the same time
Driving above the blood alcohol limit
twin.explain_zh: lawful = 合法（unlawful 才是違法，只差 un-）。和平抗議合法。同時和多人結婚（polygamy）、酒駕都違法。

options_zh: 在法庭上，每個人的名字叫什麼
在法庭上，每個人有權得到什麼

drills.question_en: In an Australian court, every person is entitled to:
options_en: be found guilty without any evidence
tell the judge what to decide
drills.tip_zh: entitled to = 有權。沒有 to 時（a book entitled…）才是“名為”。
drills.explain_zh: entitled to = 有權（享有）。每個人都有權請律師代表自己。法庭只能根據證據判決；法官是獨立的，沒人能告訴法官怎麼判。

drills.question_en: Who is eligible to stand for the Australian Parliament?
options_en: A citizen who is at least 18 and holds only Australian citizenship
drills.tip_zh: eligible = 有資格，不是 legible（看得清）。
drills.explain_zh: eligible = 有資格。年滿 18 歲、不是雙重國籍的澳大利亞公民，才可以參選議員。

options_zh: 不論某個條件怎樣，都按能力決定
因為某個條件，所以得到工作

drills.question_en: In Australia, a job should be given to whoever has the strongest skills and experience, regardless of their:
drills.tip_zh: regardless of = 不論、不管。後面跟的東西不影響結果。
drills.explain_zh: regardless of = 不論。找工作看能力和經驗，不論性別、財富或民族。資格（qualifications，學歷、證書等）和工作經歷（work history）正是要看的東西，所以不選。

drills.question_en: If you are enrolled and do not vote in a federal election, you could be fined unless:
options_en: you simply did not feel like voting
your friends did not vote either
you have a valid reason for not voting
drills.tip_zh: unless = 除非。“A unless B” = 除非 B，否則 A。
drills.explain_zh: unless = 除非。意思是：不投票可能要交罰款，除非你有正當理由。只是不想投、朋友也沒投，都不算正當理由。

decode.prompt_zh: “You must not drive unless you have a licence” 是什麼意思？

drills.question_en: In Australia, you must not drive a car unless:
options_en: you hold a local driver's licence and your car is registered
drills.tip_zh: must not + unless 兩個否定放在一起，慢慢讀：除非……否則不準。
drills.explain_zh: must not … unless … = 除非……，否則不準……。也就是：要有本地駕照，車也要註冊，才可以開車。

decode.prompt_zh: “neither A nor B” 是什麼意思？
options_zh: A 或 B 其中一個

drills.question_en: Which statement about judges in Australia is correct?
options_en: They are controlled by both parliament and the government.
They are controlled by neither parliament nor the government.
They are controlled by the government but not by parliament.
drills.tip_zh: 看到 neither，就知道後面兩個都被否定了。
drills.explain_zh: neither … nor … = 既不……也不……。法院和法官獨立於議會，也獨立於政府，兩邊都不能控制他們。

decode.prompt_zh: “instead of X” 裏的 X 是什麼？
options_zh: 不該選擇、被替換掉的做法

drills.question_en: In Australia, people try to change laws and minds by talking and voting, instead of:
drills.tip_zh: instead of 後面的是“沒被選擇”的那個。
drills.explain_zh: instead of = 而不是。澳大利亞人通過討論、和平説服和民主程序來推動改變，拒絕用暴力。辯論和選舉本身就是“談話和投票”，所以不選。

drills.question_en: In each state, the Governor acts on behalf of:
drills.tip_zh: on behalf of = 代表某人、以某人的名義。
drills.explain_zh: on behalf of = 代表。州總督（Governor）在州里代表國王。注意：州長（Premier）是州政府的領導人，不是州總督。

drills.question_en: Who has the power to make laws in Australia?
drills.tip_zh: make = 制定，enforce = 執行，interpret = 解釋。
drills.explain_zh: make laws = 制定法律，這是議會的權力（立法權）。解釋法律是法院的事，維持秩序是警察的事。

twin.question_en: Who decides what a law means when people disagree about it?
twin.explain_zh: decide what a law means = 解釋法律（interpret）。這是法官的權力（司法權）。

options_zh: 誰執行法律（讓大家遵守）

drills.question_en: Who enforces the law in Australia?
drills.tip_zh: enforce = 執行，不是“制定”。
drills.explain_zh: enforce = 執行（讓大家遵守）。警察維持秩序，相信有人犯法時可以逮捕，並把人帶上法庭；判定有沒有罪的是法院。議會是制定（make）法律的，政黨不執行法律。

drills.question_en: Which group do Australian laws apply to?
drills.tip_zh: apply to = 適用於，不是“申請”（apply for）。
drills.explain_zh: apply to = 適用於。澳大利亞法律適用於在澳大利亞的所有人，不論背景和文化，不只是公民。

options_zh: 問你最合適的做法是什麼

drills.question_en: You think your neighbour might be about to commit a serious crime. What is the most appropriate thing to do?
options_en: Say nothing so you do not upset them
Warn the neighbour that you know
drills.tip_zh: most appropriate = 最合適的。選最守法、最能保護社會的做法。
drills.explain_zh: 懷疑有人計劃嚴重犯罪，應該儘快向政府有關部門報告，這樣能保護社區安全。不説或者去提醒對方都不是合適的做法。

drills.question_en: A police officer makes a lawful request for you to move your car. What is the best thing to do?
options_en: Offer the officer money so you can stay
drills.tip_zh: best = 最好的。價值觀題選最守法、最和平、最尊重他人的那個。
drills.explain_zh: 警察的合法要求應該服從和支持。拒絕並大聲爭吵不合適；給警察錢是行賄，是嚴重犯罪。

scenarios.value_area: Commitment to the Rule of Law
scenarios.scenario_en: Mr Zhang is driving home at 2 am. The road is empty and there are no cameras. The traffic light in front of him turns red.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 凌晨兩點，張先生開車回家。路上沒人，也沒有攝像頭。前面的紅綠燈變紅了。
options_en: Stop and wait until the light turns green again
Drive through, because nobody can see him
Drive through slowly, because it is very late
why_zh: 對。堅守法治（rule of law）的意思是：任何時候都要守法，就算沒人看見也一樣。
錯。“沒人看見”不是違法的理由。澳大利亞人守法，不是因為怕被抓。
錯。開得慢、時間晚都不能改變規則。紅燈就是要停。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 沒人看見，也要守法。

scenarios.scenario_en: Mr Ho is a rich businessman and a well-known community leader. He gets a parking fine. He tells his friends that important people like him do not have to pay.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 何先生是有錢的商人，也是有名的社區領袖。他收到一張停車罰單，卻對朋友説：像他這樣的重要人物不用交。
options_en: Yes, community leaders have special rights
No, everyone must obey the law, including leaders
Yes, if he gives the same amount of money to charity
why_zh: 錯。在澳大利亞，沒有人可以凌駕於法律之上，領袖也沒有“特權”可以不守法。
對。法治的意思是人人在法律面前平等。政府官員、宗教領袖、商人、警察都必須守法。
錯。捐錢給慈善機構不能代替交罰款。法律對每個人都一樣。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 再有錢、再有地位，也不在法律之上。

scenarios.value_area: Commitment to the Rule of Law
scenarios.scenario_en: Wei moved to Australia six months ago. He breaks a law that he did not know about. He says that in his old country this was allowed, and nobody told him.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 阿偉半年前搬到澳大利亞。他違反了一條他不知道的法律。他説：在原來的國家這是允許的，也沒人告訴過他。
options_en: Wei cannot be charged, because he did not know the law
Wei can still be charged; not knowing a law is no excuse
Wei only has to follow the laws of his old country
why_zh: 錯。“我不知道”不能免責。住在澳大利亞就有責任瞭解這裏的法律。
對。不知道法律不是藉口（not knowing the law is no excuse），照樣可能被起訴。
錯。不管你來自哪裏、是什麼文化背景，在澳大利亞都必須遵守澳大利亞法律。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 不知道法律，不是藉口。

scenarios.value_area: Commitment to the Rule of Law
scenarios.scenario_en: Lan is visiting her son in Australia on a tourist visa. She thinks Australian laws are only for Australian citizens, not for visitors like her.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 蘭阿姨拿旅遊簽證來澳大利亞看兒子。她以為澳大利亞的法律只管公民，不管她這樣的遊客。
options_en: Yes, visitors follow the laws of their own country
No, but visitors only need to obey laws on serious crimes
No, Australian laws apply to everyone who is in Australia
why_zh: 錯。在澳大利亞境內，遊客也必須守澳大利亞的法律，不是按自己國家的法律。
錯。不只是嚴重犯罪的法律，所有澳大利亞法律都適用於遊客。
對。澳大利亞法律適用於在澳大利亞的所有人：公民、永久居民、遊客都一樣。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 人在澳大利亞，就守澳大利亞的法。

scenarios.scenario_en: A new law says dogs must be on a lead (leash) in all parks. Hao thinks the law is unfair, because his dog is friendly.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 一條新法律規定：在所有公園裏狗都必須拴繩。小浩覺得不公平，因為他的狗很友善。
scenarios.question_en: What is the right way for Hao to try to change the law?
options_en: Ignore the law until the government decides to change it
Contact his MP and campaign peacefully for the law to change
Pull down the new signs in the park so people ignore it
why_zh: 錯。不同意一條法律，也要在它被修改之前繼續遵守。
對。在澳大利亞可以通過民主途徑改變法律：聯繫議員、討論、和平地宣傳和爭取支持。
錯。破壞公物是違法的。用違法的方法改變法律是不能接受的。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 不同意法律？先守法，再用民主途徑爭取修改。

scenarios.scenario_en: A group of people are angry about a government decision. One member says they should threaten politicians, or use violence, to make the government change the law.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 一羣人對政府的一個決定很生氣。其中一人説，應該威脅政治人物，或者用暴力，逼政府改法律。
options_en: Violence is acceptable if a law is very unfair to people
Threats are acceptable, but real violence is not acceptable
Threats and violence are never acceptable ways to change a law
why_zh: 錯。再不公平的法律，也不能用暴力去改。澳大利亞人拒絕用暴力改變別人的想法或法律。
錯。威脅（恐嚇）也不行。人人都有免受暴力和恐嚇的權利。
對。改變法律要靠討論、和平説服和民主程序，例如選舉、聯繫議員、和平抗議。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 改法律靠選票和討論，不靠拳頭和恐嚇。

scenarios.scenario_en: Mrs Wong became an Australian citizen last year. A federal election is coming. She says she is too busy to vote this time, and that voting is just a choice.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 黃太太去年入籍。聯邦大選快到了。她説這次太忙不去投票了，反正投票只是自己選擇的事。
options_en: Voting is compulsory for Australian citizens, so she must vote
Only citizens who were born in Australia have to vote
She only has to vote if she supports a political party
why_zh: 對。在澳大利亞，18歲以上的公民必須在聯邦和州/領地選舉中投票（compulsory，強制投票）。
錯。入籍的公民和在澳大利亞出生的公民一樣，都有投票的責任。
錯。不支持任何政黨也要去投票。投票是公民的責任，不是隻給政黨支持者的。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 入籍以後，投票是責任，不是可選項。

scenarios.scenario_en: Jun posts online that he disagrees with a new government policy. His aunt warns him that he could get into trouble for criticising the government.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 阿俊在網上發帖，説他不同意政府的一項新政策。他姑姑提醒他：批評政府可能會惹麻煩。
options_en: No, people may criticise the government, within the law
Yes, criticising the government is against the law
Yes, only newspapers and TV are allowed to criticise the government
why_zh: 對。言論自由是澳大利亞的核心價值觀：人們可以説出和寫下自己的想法，包括批評政府，只要不違法。
錯。在澳大利亞，批評政府是合法的，這是言論自由的一部分。
錯。報紙、電視、電台有這種自由，普通人也同樣有。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 可以批評政府，但説話也要守法。

scenarios.scenario_en: Sarah is angry with her neighbour. She posts online that the neighbour stole money from her, but she knows this is not true.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 莎拉很生鄰居的氣。她在網上説鄰居偷了她的錢，但她自己知道這不是真的。
scenarios.question_en: Is this protected by freedom of speech?
options_en: Yes, freedom of speech means you can say anything
No, unless she only posts it on her own page
No, making false allegations like this is against the law
why_zh: 錯。言論自由有界限：説話也必須守法，不能用來傷害別人。
錯。發在自己的主頁上也是公開發表，假的指控一樣違法。
對。在澳大利亞，作出虛假指控（false allegations）是違法的。言論自由不包括造謠誣陷別人。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 言論自由 ≠ 想説什麼就説什麼。造謠違法。

scenarios.scenario_en: Students are planning a protest against a government decision. Most want to march peacefully. A few want to break shop windows to get more attention.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 學生們打算抗議政府的一個決定。大部分人想和平遊行，少數人想砸商店櫥窗來吸引更多注意。
scenarios.question_en: Which kind of protest is allowed in Australia?
options_en: A peaceful protest that harms no person or property
Any protest at all, as long as the cause is a good one
A protest that damages property but does not hurt people
why_zh: 對。澳大利亞人可以和平抗議政府的決定。抗議必須守法：和平進行，不傷人，不毀壞財物。
錯。目的再好，抗議也必須守法。理由好不能讓暴力或破壞變成合法。
錯。毀壞財物也是違法的，就算沒人受傷也不行。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 抗議可以，必須和平：不傷人，不砸東西。

scenarios.scenario_en: Ming starts a new job in a factory. A co-worker tells him that he must join the trade union, or he will lose his job.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 阿明在一家工廠開始新工作。一個同事告訴他：必須加入工會，否則會丟工作。
options_en: Ming is free to choose whether to join the union
Ming must join, because all his co-workers are members
Ming must join, but he can leave after one year
why_zh: 對。結社自由的意思是：可以自由加入合法的團體，例如政黨、工會、宗教或文化團體，也可以選擇不加入。
錯。別人都加入了，也不代表你必須加入。沒人可以被強迫加入一個組織。
錯。加入和退出都是自願的，沒有“必須先待一年”這種規定。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 加不加入團體，自己決定，沒人能強迫。

scenarios.scenario_en: Aunty Fang has been in a cultural association for ten years. Now she wants to leave, but the leader says members are not allowed to quit.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 芳姨在一個文化協會待了十年，現在想退出。但會長説：會員不準退出。
scenarios.question_en: Can Aunty Fang leave the association?
options_en: No, she must stay, because she made a promise when she joined
Yes, but only if the leader agrees
Yes, people are free to leave a group whenever they choose
why_zh: 錯。入會時的承諾不能把人永遠綁住。在澳大利亞，退出團體是每個人的自由。
錯。會長不能決定她能不能走。沒人可以被強迫留在一個組織里。
對。結社自由包括退出的自由：人們可以自願加入或離開任何合法團體。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 想加入就加入，想退出就退出。

scenarios.scenario_en: Li Na is a Buddhist. A new friend asks her whether Buddhists have the same rights as Christians in Australia, because many public holidays are Christian.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 李娜是佛教徒。一個新朋友問她：澳大利亞很多公眾假期是基督教節日，那佛教徒和基督徒的權利一樣嗎？
options_en: No, Christians have more rights, because Christianity is the official religion
Yes, the law treats people of all religions equally
Only Buddhists who are citizens have the same rights
why_zh: 錯。澳大利亞有猶太-基督教傳統，也有基督教節日的公眾假期，但沒有官方國教，基督徒也沒有更多權利。
對。政府和法律平等對待所有人，不管信什麼宗教，或者不信宗教。佛教徒和基督徒受到同樣的對待。
錯。澳大利亞社會重視所有人的平等權利，不分宗教，不是隻有公民才平等。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 沒有國教，信什麼（或不信）都平等。

scenarios.scenario_en: Kevin does not follow any religion. A colleague tells him that every Australian has to belong to a religion.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 凱文不信任何宗教。一個同事跟他説：每個澳大利亞人都必須有宗教信仰。
options_en: No, people can choose to follow no religion
Yes, everyone must choose a religion
Yes, but people can choose any religion they like
why_zh: 對。宗教自由包括兩方面：可以信任何宗教，也可以不信宗教。
錯。在澳大利亞沒有人必須信宗教。
錯。可以選擇任何宗教是對的，但“必須有宗教”是錯的。不信宗教也完全可以。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 信教自由，不信教也自由。

scenarios.scenario_en: A religious leader tells his group that their religious rules are more important than Australian law. He says members should follow the religious rule when the two are different.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 一位宗教領袖對信眾説：他們的教規比澳大利亞法律更重要。兩者不同時，應該聽教規的。
options_en: Religious rules come first for members of that religion
People can choose which rule they want to follow
Australian law comes first when the two are different
why_zh: 錯。在澳大利亞，宗教法規沒有法律地位，不能高於國家法律。
錯。不能自己挑。法律對每個人都有約束力，不管信不信教。
對。宗教活動也必須守法。澳大利亞法律和宗教做法有衝突時，以澳大利亞法律為準。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 教規和法律衝突時，法律優先。

scenarios.scenario_en: Mr Gray is already married. He says that in some cultures a man can have two wives, so he can take a second wife in Australia.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 格雷先生已經結婚了。他説：在有些文化裏，一個男人可以有兩個妻子，所以他在澳大利亞也可以再娶一個。
options_en: Yes, as long as his first wife and the second wife agree
No, a person can only have one spouse at a time
No, unless it is a family tradition
why_zh: 錯。就算兩個妻子都同意也不行。一夫多妻（重婚，polygamy）在澳大利亞違法，可能被判刑。
對。在澳大利亞，同一時間只能和一個人結婚。一夫多妻（重婚，polygamy）違法，可能受到嚴厲懲罰，包括坐牢。
錯。文化習俗或家族傳統不能凌駕於法律之上。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 同一時間只能有一個配偶。

scenarios.scenario_en: Lucy is 22. Her parents have chosen a husband for her and are pressuring her to marry him. She does not want to.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 露西22歲。父母給她選了一個丈夫，一直逼她嫁。她不願意。
options_en: Her parents can decide, because they know what is best
It is allowed if the two families agreed before she came to Australia
She has the right to say no. Forcing someone to marry is illegal.
why_zh: 錯。在澳大利亞，結婚是個人自己的決定。父母可以給意見，但不能替她決定。
錯。兩家人以前怎麼約定都沒用。沒有本人自願同意的婚姻就是強迫婚姻。
對。男女都有權自己決定婚姻這樣的個人事情。強迫婚姻（forced marriage）違法，懲罰很重。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 嫁不嫁、娶不娶，本人説了算。

scenarios.value_area: Equality of all people under the law
scenarios.scenario_en: Peng is 30. His parents are Christian, but Peng decides to become a Buddhist. His parents tell him he is not allowed to change his religion.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 阿鵬30歲。父母是基督徒，但阿鵬決定改信佛教。父母説不準他改。
options_en: Peng is an adult, so he decides for himself
His parents decide, because they are older
The leader of his parents' church decides
why_zh: 對。宗教是個人的事。成年人有權自己決定信什麼宗教，受法律保護，不受恐嚇。
錯。尊重長輩很好，但父母不能替成年子女決定信仰。
錯。宗教領袖也不能替別人決定信仰。宗教自由屬於每一個人。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 信什麼，自己決定。

scenarios.value_area: Equality of all people under the law
scenarios.scenario_en: Two people apply for a manager job. Anna has better qualifications and more skills than the man who also applied. The boss wants to give the job to the man, because he thinks men should be in charge.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 兩個人申請經理職位。安娜的資歷和技能都比另一位男性申請人好。但老闆想把工作給那個男的，因為他覺得應該由男人來管事。
options_en: Anna should get the job, as she is better qualified
The man should get the job, because he is a man
The boss can choose by gender if he owns the company
why_zh: 對。男女平等：女性資歷和技能更好時，有權比男性先得到工作。工作應該看能力和經驗。
錯。因為性別而歧視別人是違法的。
錯。公司老闆也必須守反歧視的法律，不能按性別選人。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 選人看能力，不看性別。

scenarios.value_area: Equality of all people under the law
scenarios.scenario_en: Mei Ling wants to join the Australian Defence Force after she finishes school. Her uncle says that only men can join the army.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 美玲畢業後想加入澳大利亞國防軍。她舅舅説：只有男人才能參軍。
options_en: No, women can join both the Defence Force and the police
Yes, only men are allowed to join the Defence Force
Yes, women can only work in an office in the army
why_zh: 對。男女權利平等：都可以受教育、工作、投票、競選議員、加入國防軍和警隊，在法庭上也受到平等對待。
錯。在澳大利亞，女性可以參軍。
錯。男女都可以加入國防軍，機會對男女是平等的。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 參軍、當警察、競選議員：男女都可以。

scenarios.value_area: Equality of all people under the law
scenarios.scenario_en: Mrs Chen is unhappy in her marriage and wants a divorce. Her husband tells her that she cannot get a divorce unless he agrees.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 陳太太婚姻不幸福，想離婚。丈夫説：他不同意，她就離不了。
options_en: She can apply to the court for a divorce without his agreement
Only a husband is able to apply to court for a divorce
She needs permission from her husband's family first
why_zh: 對。在澳大利亞可以離婚。丈夫或妻子任何一方都可以向法院申請，就算另一方想繼續婚姻也可以。
錯。男女平等，妻子和丈夫都有權申請離婚。
錯。離婚是夫妻本人的事，由法院處理，不需要家族同意。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 想離婚，任何一方都可以向法院申請。

scenarios.value_area: Equality of all people under the law
scenarios.scenario_en: Mark sometimes hits his wife when he is angry. He says it is a private family matter and nobody else's business.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 馬克生氣時有時會打老婆。他説這是家裏的私事，跟別人無關。
options_en: Yes, what happens inside the home is private
No, but only if it happens often
No, violence against a partner is a crime in Australia
why_zh: 錯。家暴不是“家務事”。在家裏、在婚姻裏的暴力一樣違法，應該報警。
錯。打一次也是犯罪，次數多少都一樣。
對。對配偶或伴侶使用暴力永遠不能接受，在澳大利亞是刑事犯罪，可以坐牢。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 家暴不是家務事，是犯罪。有危險請聯繫警察；更多幫助見 1800respect.org.au。

scenarios.value_area: Equality of all people under the law
scenarios.scenario_en: Jenny's husband never hits her. But he takes her phone, stops her from seeing her friends and family, and threatens her when she goes out alone.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 珍妮的丈夫從來不打她。但他拿走她的手機，不讓她見朋友和家人，她一個人出門就威脅她。
options_en: Yes, it is fine because he never actually hits her
No, this kind of control is family violence
Yes, a husband is allowed to make rules for his wife
why_zh: 錯。家庭暴力不只是打人。用威脅和孤立來控制伴侶也是家暴。
對。家庭暴力包括讓伴侶害怕、威脅伴侶的安全、把家人和親友隔開。這些都違法，可以報警求助。
錯。夫妻權利平等。丈夫不能“管”妻子，男女都有權自己做決定，不受恐嚇。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 控制、威脅、孤立伴侶，也是家暴。有危險請聯繫警察；更多幫助見 1800respect.org.au。

scenarios.value_area: Equality of all people under the law
scenarios.scenario_en: Tom and David are two men who have been together for five years. They want to get married in Australia.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 湯姆和大衞是兩個男人，在一起五年了。他們想在澳大利亞結婚。
scenarios.question_en: Can they marry under Australian law?
options_en: Yes, same-sex marriage is legal in Australia
No, only a man and a woman can marry each other
Only if they get married in another country
why_zh: 對。根據澳大利亞法律，兩個人可以結婚，包括兩個男人或兩個女人。
錯。澳大利亞法律允許同性婚姻，不只是一男一女。
錯。他們不需要出國，在澳大利亞就可以合法結婚。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 在澳大利亞，同性婚姻合法。

scenarios.value_area: Equality of all people under the law
scenarios.scenario_en: Raj wants to rent a flat. The owner tells him that he does not rent to people of Raj's race.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 拉吉想租一套房子。房東説：他不租給拉吉這個種族的人。
options_en: Yes, an owner can choose a tenant for any reason
Yes, if the owner says it politely
No, racial discrimination is against the law
why_zh: 錯。房東不能因為種族區別對待租客。澳大利亞有法律保護人們不因種族被區別對待。
錯。説得再客氣，歧視還是歧視。
對。澳大利亞有法律保護人們不因性別、種族、殘疾或年齡被區別對待。種族歧視違法。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 不能因為種族區別對待別人。

scenarios.value_area: Equality of opportunity and a ‘fair go’
scenarios.scenario_en: A restaurant owner needs a new chef. She must choose between her nephew, who has little experience, and a stranger with many years of experience.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 一家餐館老闆要招新廚師。一邊是經驗很少的外甥，一邊是有多年經驗的陌生人。
scenarios.question_en: Under Australian values, how should she choose?
options_en: She should always choose her own family first
She should choose the person from the richest family
She should choose whoever has the best skills and experience
why_zh: 錯。“任人唯親”不符合公平機會（fair go）的價值觀。
錯。家裏有沒有錢不應該決定誰得到工作。
對。Fair go（公平機會）的一個體現是：工作應該看技能和經驗。法律也支持選技能和經驗最好的人。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: Fair go：憑本事，不憑關係，不憑家世。

scenarios.value_area: Equality of opportunity and a ‘fair go’
scenarios.scenario_en: Hui's parents were poor farmers. Hui worries that people from a poor background cannot become successful in Australia.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 小慧的父母是窮苦的農民。小慧擔心：出身貧窮的人在澳大利亞沒法成功。
options_en: Hard work and talent matter, not family background
Only people from rich families can become leaders here
New migrants cannot become leaders in business
why_zh: 對。在澳大利亞，不管背景如何，每個人都有平等的機會成功。成就應該來自努力和才能。
錯。家庭財富不應該決定一個人能走多遠。澳大利亞沒有正式的階級區分。
錯。很多新移民靠努力在商業、專業、藝術、公共服務和體育方面成了領袖。
scenarios.takeaway_zh: 出身不決定未來，努力和才能才決定。

scenarios.value_area: Equality of opportunity and a ‘fair go’
scenarios.scenario_en: At a community event, a man says everyone should treat him as more important, because his family comes from a high social class.
scenarios.scenario_zh: 在一次社區活動上，一個男人説大家都應該把他看得更重要，因為他家出身上層階級。
